name: vllm_cutlass_scaled_mm_azp
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_cutlass_scaled_mm_azp.py. INT8 scaled GEMM with azp (activation zero-point) correction: a (M,K) int8, b (K,N) int8 column-major (built .t().contiguous().t()), scale_a (M,1)/scale_b (1,N) fp32 positive (rand+0.5), azp_adj (N,) int32 in [-8,9), azp (M,) int32 in [-8,9), bias (N,) fp16, out_dtype fixed torch.float16. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.cutlass_scaled_mm_azp and returns the (M,N) fp16 result. Positive scales / small azp ranges and column-major b require gen_inputs; only a and bias are plain random. Source parametrizes (has_azp,has_bias); migrated workloads fix has_azp=True,has_bias=True. No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
